## A stage at a different authored size {#resized-content}

This deck overrides the stage geometry to 1920 x 1080. Both the CSS box and the
JavaScript fit transform have to follow it, which is the property the test
asserts: the stylesheet is the single source of truth and the transform reads
it back.
